title: 第13章 风洛依的探视第14章 这样的圣宗
slug: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
lines: 沈云其实也没什么好交接的。
总管这个位置，给他们任何一个人都能干，主要是得到家主信任。
下午交代完毕，沈云看着账房内的各个角落，每一处都带着回忆。
硬木边柜中，放满了他珍藏多年的茶叶。
挑了几盒最好的带走，剩下留给后来人。
在风家呆了这么多年，很有感情。
“沈伯是想留在族中养老，还是想与我去往圣城，为我看守灵田？”
就在这时，突然身后传来一个声音。
吓得他一个激灵，手中茶叶掉到了地上。
“风洛依。”
沈云回过神来有了判断。
听声音成熟不少，这种清冷平淡的音色，却始终没有改变。
他转过身来，身后房门未开，凭空出现一位红衣女子，飘逸出尘。
沈云微微一愣，果然是她。
“见过大小姐，我愿随您去圣城。”
并未因小时候两人关系而怠慢，沈云连忙躬身行礼。
“悄然无声的出现在房间，是穿墙吗？我什么时候能到这种境界....不知道人吓人吓死人？等我有实力了，定要吓回来。”沈云心思流转。
“沈伯，不必向我行礼，以前你教导过我很多。”
风洛依语气清冷，伸手虚空一抬，轻松将他搀扶起来。
看在过去的情分，她来一趟，是给沈云一个选择的机会。
“不敢谈教导，只是编造的些许荒唐故事。”
沈云连忙摇头否认。
这个大小姐看似清冷，对一切都不在意，实际上是个心思细腻的主。
“去了圣城，接触真正的修行界，相信沈伯能编造出更多好故事。”
风洛依仔细打量了十几年未见的沈伯，普普通通的老头，入阶修行全靠血食和血元丹。
最大的优点是对风家很忠诚，这么多年极少贪墨。
话音落下，风洛依的身影逐渐虚幻，飘然离去。
“恭送大小姐。”
确定风洛依离开，沈云这才直起身子，继续收拾东西。
还好他没什么隐秘怕被看去，就算他的呼吸法，风洛依也看不上。
最大的隐秘古卷，给她看，她也看不见。
没什么好怕的。
content_en:
Shen Yun actually had nothing to explain.
Any one of them can take on the position of general manager. The main thing is to gain the trust of the family head.
After finishing the explanation in the afternoon, Shen Yun looked at every corner of the accounting room, with memories everywhere.
The hardwood side cabinet is filled with tea leaves that he has collected for many years.
I picked out a few boxes of the best ones and took them away, leaving the rest for future generations.
Having stayed in the Feng family for so many years, I am very affectionate.
"Uncle Shen, do you want to stay in the clan and retire, or do you want to go to the Holy City with me and guard the spiritual field for me?"
At this moment, a voice suddenly came from behind.
He was so frightened that the tea leaves in his hand fell to the ground.
"Feng Luoyi."
Chen Yun came to his senses and made a judgment.
It sounds like the voice has matured a lot, but this cool and plain tone has never changed.
He turned around, but before the door opened behind him, a woman in red appeared out of thin air, floating elegantly out of the dust.
Chen Yun was slightly startled, it was indeed her.
"I have met the eldest lady, and I am willing to accompany you to the Holy City."
Not being negligent because of their childhood relationship, Shen Yun quickly bowed and saluted.
"Appearing quietly in the room, is it through the wall? When will I reach this state... I don't know how to scare people to death? When I have the strength, I will scare them back." Chen Yun's thoughts were flowing.
"Uncle Shen, there is no need to salute me. You taught me a lot before."
Feng Luoyi's tone was cold, and he stretched out his hand to help him up easily.
In view of past friendship, she came here to give Shen Yun a chance to choose.
"I don't dare to talk about teachings. They are just fabricated absurd stories."
Shen Yun quickly shook his head in denial.
This eldest lady seems cold and doesn't care about anything, but she is actually a considerate person.
"I went to the Holy City and got in touch with the real world of cultivation. I believe Uncle Shen can make up more good stories."
Feng Luoyi carefully looked at Uncle Shen, whom he had not seen for more than ten years. He was an ordinary old man, and his cultivation relied entirely on blood food and blood essence pills.
The biggest advantage is that he is very loyal to the Feng family and has rarely been greedy for so many years.
After the words fell, Feng Luoyi's figure gradually became illusory and floated away.
"Congratulations, young lady."
After confirming that Feng Luoyi had left, Shen Yun straightened up and continued to pack his things.
Fortunately, he had nothing to hide and was afraid of being seen. Even his breathing technique was not favored by Feng Luoyi.
Even if I show her the biggest secret ancient scroll, she can't see it.
There is nothing to be afraid of.
